text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After much deliberation over which race to make her final one, she ultimately decides to leave the choice to me. But which of the four options should I choose?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first option is the momentous and historical autumn Tenno Sho, a race that Zenno Rob Roy—who compared Fine Motion to the main character of a story—intends to enter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The second option is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. It's a majestic race filled with countless memories, and entering it would allow for another showdown with the Empress, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The third option, the Mile Championship, would make for an equally interesting race. Kawakami Princess, who gave Fine Motion an intense "princess showdown," will also be running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then there's the Arima Kinen, where she can race not only her close friend Daiwa Scarlet but also Air Shakur! For Fine Motion's final race, I choose…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our goal is now the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With our final objective decided, we turn our sights diligently to the race ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our goal is now the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With our final objective decided, we turn our sights diligently to the race ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our goal is now the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With our final objective decided, we turn our sights diligently to the race ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our goal is now the Arima Kinen.
